description: Read one live Xero Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet or Trial Balance for explicit dates. Capped at 250 stripped rows and never writes to Xero. Requires the matching read-only Xero report permission and a Xero user with Reports access.

date.description: Snapshot date for Balance Sheet or Trial Balance, supplied by the user; omit for Profit and Loss.

from_date.description: Inclusive start date of the Profit and Loss period requested by the user; omit for snapshot reports.

report.description: The live Xero report requested by the user; Profit and Loss needs a period, the others need a snapshot date.

to_date.description: Inclusive end date of the Profit and Loss period requested by the user; omit for snapshot reports.

workspace_id.description: Selected business ID from list_shvl_workspaces. Ask the user to choose if several businesses are available; never infer another business.

name: get_xero_financial_report

outputSchema.description: tenant_name identifies the selected Xero organisation. report, report_name, report_date and parameters identify the requested report and dates. rows contains typed, nested display cells, section and depth; preserve the provider headers and units when interpreting values. row_count counts returned rows and truncated signals omissions. is_live and data_source identify a live Xero report; updated_at may be null.

title: Get a live Xero financial report
